approved.en: Sanctions have been applied to eight Israeli construction firms for building West Bank settlements, intended to support a two-state solution. An Israeli airstrike on Gaza’s Nasser Hospital killed a doctor and a child, and later killed three Hamas militants, including an Oct. 7 attacker. Israeli settlers shot a Palestinian woman near Jericho and were involved in a car-ramming incident that was judged not a terror attack, while the government froze the controversial E1 settlement tender process pending a new administration. The Board of Peace warned that the Gaza ceasefire faces imminent collapse without action. 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israelske bosettere skjøt en palestinsk kvinne nær Jeriko og var involvert i en bilkollisjon som ble vurdert som ikke et terrorangrep, mens regjeringen frøs den omstridte E1‑bosettings-tildelingsprosessen inntil en ny administrasjon. US envoy Waltz visited Beirut demanding Hezbollah disarmament and condemning recent attacks. Iraq deployed its army to a stronghold of Iran-backed Kataib Hezbollah, linking the broader regional fight to the Israel-Hezbollah clash. The conflict has caused 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

US-ambassadør Waltz besøkte Beirut og krevde at Hezbollah skal avlegges våpen og fordømte de siste angrepene. Irak har satt inn hæren i et område som er en festning for den Iran-støttede Kataib Hezbollah, og knytter den bredere regionale kampen til konflikten mellom Israel og Hezbollah. Konflikten har forårsaket 4 335 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iran has launched drone attacks on a U.S. radar system at Sheikh Isa air base in Bahrain and on targets in Kuwait, while also claiming its mines struck five ships in the Hormuz Strait. The United States responded with self-defence airstrikes on Iranian missile launch sites on Qeshm Island and on vessels in the Gulf of Oman. A whistleblower said the deadly drone strike in Kuwait could have been avoided. The conflict now includes simultaneous aerial and maritime engagements across Bahrain, Kuwait, Qeshm Island and the Gulf of Oman. 123 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA svarte med selvforsvarsluftangrep på iranske missilutskytningssteder på Qeshm-øya og på fartøy i Omanbukta. En varsler sa at det dødelige droneangrepet i Kuwait kunne ha blitt unngått. Konflikten omfatter nå samtidige luft‑ og sjøengasjementer over Bahrain, Kuwait, Qeshm-øya og Omanbukta. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthis now control the Bab al-Mandeb strait and surrounding positions after Yemeni government forces withdrew, securing the key maritime chokepoint while pushing within about 60 km of Aden. Saudi Arabia dismissed its coalition commander as the anti-Houthi forces pulled back from the strait and other key areas, and the Yemeni parliament designated the Houthis as terrorists, prompting concerns of a resurgence by southern separatists. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Saudi-Arabia avskjediget sin koalisjonskommandør da de anti-houthi styrkene trakk seg tilbake fra stredet og andre nøkkelområder, og det jemenittiske parlamentet erklærte houthiene som terrorister, noe som vekker bekymring for en oppblussing fra sørlige separatister. Konflikten forårsaket 918 drepte i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Jordan condemned Israeli incursions and sentenced three people to death for a Greek Orthodox church attack. The UN noted that progress in Syria is real but fragile, and OCHA warned Syrians cannot afford more instability. UCDP recorded 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to its count.

approved.en: Iraqi security forces have intensified operations in the Kataib Hezbollah strongholds of Jurf al-Sakhar and Jurf al-Nasr, while Prime Minister Al-Zaidi ordered an inquiry into oil smuggling and threatened force to enforce a militia withdrawal deadline. Iran’s top IRGC commander arrived in Iraq for talks amid tensions with Kataib Hezbollah, and reports suggest Iran may be planning a dirty bomb attack in the US. Jordan and Iraq jointly blocked Telegram over national security and regulatory concerns, and the US consulate is conducting security tests in Erbil. Baghdad and Iran reached a deal for Kataib Hezbollah to leave Jurf al-Sakhar, and a former hostage said she was held in a militia stronghold targeted by the prime minister. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Irans øverste IRGC-kommandør ankom Irak for samtaler midt i spenninger med Kataib Hezbollah, og rapporter antyder at Iran kan planlegge et skittent bombetiltak i USA. Jordan og Irak blokkerte i fellesskap Telegram av nasjonale sikkerhets‑ og reguleringshensyn, og den amerikanske konsuleringen gjennomfører sikkerhetstester i Erbil. Bagdad og Iran nådde en avtale om at Kataib Hezbollah skal forlate Jurf al-Sakhar, og en tidligere gissel sa at hun ble holdt i en militær festning som ble målrettet av statsministeren. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

A former Sudanese information minister was attacked in Uganda, and a former Sudanese official wanted by the ICC was arrested, confirming U.S. involvement. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Federal forces continue advancing in Tigray while militia attacks near the Ethiopia-Kenya border have killed civilians and displaced thousands, pushing the refugee count in Kenya above 50,000. Ethiopian drones are operating over Sudan and RSF drones are launching from Ethiopian territory against Sudanese targets, prompting diplomatic expulsions and consular closures. Ethiopia blames Egypt and Eritrea for supporting Tigray attacks, and Eritrean forces have carried out drone and artillery strikes near Badme. Heavy weapon clashes have spread on the Oromia-Somali border to Mieso and Afdem, and fighting in Moyale deepens a territorial dispute. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Den føderale styrken fortsetter fremrykkingen i Tigray, mens militsangrep nær Etiopia-Kenya-grensen har drept sivile og fordrevet tusenvis, noe som har ført til at antallet flyktninger i Kenya har passert 50 000. Etiopiske droner opererer over Sudan, og RSF-droner blir lansert fra etiopisk territorium mot sudanske mål, noe som har ført til diplomatiske utvisninger og konsulære stenginger. Etiopia anklager Egypt og Eritrea for å støtte angrep i Tigray, og eritreiske styrker har utført drone‑ og artilleriangrep nær Badme. Tunge våpen-konflikter har spredt seg på grensen mellom Oromia og Somali til Mieso og Afdem, og kamper i Moyale forsterker en territoriekonflikt. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
